name: The Peninsula Shanghai

address.street: No 32 The Bund 32 Zhongshan Dong Yi Road

insider_take: Where East meets West in spectacular fashion, The Peninsula Shanghai stands as a beacon of luxury on the historic Bund waterfront.
whats_special: This Art Deco masterpiece features the largest Rolls-Royce fleet in China and houses one of Asia's most extensive spa facilities. The hotel's rooftop helipad offers exclusive helicopter transfers, while its position directly on the Bund provides unparalleled views of both the historic colonial architecture and Pudong's futuristic skyline across the Huangpu River.
pro_tip: Book a Bund-facing suite for sunset cocktails - the view transforms from golden colonial elegance to a neon-lit cyberpunk dreamscape as night falls over Pudong's skyscrapers.
dont_miss: The hotel's legendary afternoon tea service in the lobby, featuring traditional British customs with Chinese influences, and a evening stroll along the Bund Promenade just steps from your door - it's Shanghai's most romantic walkway with breathtaking river views.
pros: Prime location on the historic Bund with spectacular Huangpu River and Pudong skyline views
Legendary Peninsula service standards with personalized attention and fleet of Rolls-Royce vehicles
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities including indoor pool and comprehensive fitness center
Multiple award-winning dining venues featuring international and authentic Chinese cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Historic Bund location can experience heavy tourist crowds during peak seasons
